adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a new cook short-circuit in `Post#cook` (`return raw if cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`), and `TopicEmbed.import`/`import_remote` creates posts with `cook_method: :raw_html` from external RSS/remote HTML (`SimpleRSS` item content / `Readability::Document#content`) without any sanitization shown. The embed UI then renders this HTML directly via `<%= raw post.cooked %>` in `app/views/embed/best.html.erb`. This bypasses Discourse's normal cooking/sanitization pipeline, so dangerous HTML (e.g., `<script>`, event handlers, `javascript:` URLs) could be rendered if present in feed/remote content. No tests in the diff constrain or sanitize this behavior, making this a real security defect introduced/exposed by the change.
